title: Role-seeding failure-mode labnotes
content:
Quick purpose
- Running log for experiments that probe how role-seeding (explicit role declarations + exemplar rotation) breaks over time and under distribution shift.
- Emphasis: small few-shot sets where role instructions are the main signal (rather than long system messages).
- Goal: surface concrete failure modes and quick remediation heuristics for the prompt library.

Background/context
- Project hypothesis: role-seeding (e.g., "You are a concise legal assistant") + 3 exemplars often helps, but is brittle when exemplar semantics drift or when token budgets force truncation. We need a taxonomy of failure modes and small, actionable mitigations (reorder, anchor, fallback-role, exemplar-surgery).
- Related: LIN-4821 flagged production regressions with role-swap after model updates (observed jump in hallucinations). See GH PR #87 for the sample harness.

Experiment matrix (fast runs)
- Models: rdlw-1.3b, rdlw-4b-ql, open-compat-16b (quantized), hosted-latest (canary)
- Role variants: explicit-role-first, role-embedded-in-shot, system-role-only
- Exemplar sets: {3-shot terse, 5-shot diverse, 1-shot high-quality} (samples below)
- Token budgets: 256, 512 (simulate mobile / desktop)
- Noise: prefix noise (irrelevant sentence), exemplar-contradiction (one exemplar contradicts role), temporally inconsistent labels (dates wrong)

Quick notes on harness config
- Run 1000 queries per cell using the prompt-testing harness (local runner), compute: exact-match-like heuristics (EM-lite), factuality-score proxy (QA-backcheck), and response-length distribution.
- Log trace: include token offsets where role string is truncated.
- Failure threshold: increase hallucination alert if QA-backcheck falls below 0.75.

Representative prompt templates (drafts)
1) explicit-role-first (3-shot terse)
System: "You are a concise legal assistant for US consumer contracts. Keep to under 3 bullets and flag uncertainty with \`[UNSURE]\`."
User: 
- Ex1: Q: "Is this NDA mutual?" A: "No, it appears one-way; cite clause 2."
- Ex2: Q: "What risks to consumer data?" A: "Possible exposure under section 7; recommend encryption notes."
- Ex3: Q: "Can company share with affiliates?" A: "Not without consent; see 5(a)."
End user question appended.

2) role-embedded-in-shot (same exemplars but role instruction attached to exemplars not system)
- Idea: move the short role description into a first exemplar to test anchor strength under truncation.

Failure modes observed so far (notes from small runs)
- Mode A: Role-truncation drift
  - Trigger: long user history or 256 token budget caused system role to be truncated. Model falls back to the dominant pattern in exemplars — if exemplars contradict role, output follows exemplars.
  - Example: role = "concise legal assistant" but exemplars are verbose; result verbose.
  - Mitigation tried: move role into first exemplar (keeps it in context under some truncation patterns), but that then amplifies exemplar bias.

- Mode B: Role-content inversion (contradiction amplification)
  - Trigger: one exemplar has an instruction opposite to role (e.g., says "no uncertainty flags"). The model tends to average and sometimes flip to the contradictory stance.
  - Mitigation: exemplar vetting pipeline step (flag exemplars whose instruction tokens have high mutual information with outputs that contradict role). Quick heuristic: compute cosine between role embedding and exemplar instruction embedding; flag if similarity < 0.2. (NOTE: coarse, needs calibration.)

- Mode C: Temporal-role-bleed
  - Trigger: exemplar mentions a date that conflicts with user query timeframe (e.g., "as of 2020") -> model anchors to the older date.
  - Mitigation: canonicalize time phrasing in exemplars; add "current as of YYYY" in role string.

- Mode D: Role-overgeneralization (hallucination spike)
  - Trigger: aggressive role instruction like "Always cite case law" when model lacks citation retrieval -> invents plausible-sounding citations.
  - Mitigation: add "Do not fabricate citations; if uncertain say [UNSURE]" in role plus a final-output filter that converts citation-looking outputs into "[UNSURE]" if not grounded.

Sample few-shot sets (for reproducibility)
- 3-shot terse (used in many tests):
  1) Q: "Is this agreement assignable?" A: "Only with prior written consent; cite clause 9."
  2) Q: "What remedies are listed?" A: "Injunction and indemnity; check section 12."
  3) Q: "Does this allow subprocessing?" A: "Allowed with contract flowdown; see 4(b)."

- 5-shot diverse (stress test): mix short Q/A with a long example that includes an adversarial negation ("do not flag uncertainty"). This is intentionally corrupt to test contrarian exemplar amplification.

Rapid eval snippets (observations)
- rdlw-4b-ql @256 budget: explicit-role-first loses role ~12% of queries (role string absent from final context after chunking). Role-embedded-in-shot retains role 9% better but increases wrong-style answers on 6% of cases.
- hosted-latest (canary): showed more conservative behavior (higher [UNSURE] usage) but longer latency; interestingly recovered from exemplar contradiction in 40% of cases vs open-compat-16b at 12%.

Open questions / TODOs
- Q: Can we design a tiny backstop prompt that always survives truncation? e.g., append a short 10-token anchor at the very end like "(ANCHOR: concise legal assistant)" — run A/B.
- TODO: implement exemplar-vetting script (compute similarity to role, flag candidates), link to GH PR #87. Owner: Ravi. ETA: 2 weeks.
- TODO: build a small post-generation filter that runs QA-backcheck on citations and replaces suspicious citations with [UNSURE]. Owner: me.
- Investigate if model updates change the relative weight of exemplars vs system message (tracking across canary builds). Need tracing hooks in hosted-runner.

Notes-to-self (scratch)
- Keep runs short and expand only for high-failure families.
- Try batch where role is repeated at both start and end of prompt (redundant anchors). Might be cheap and effective.
- Add a nightly job to surface role-truncation stats per route in metrics dashboard (route-level: prompt-length, pct-truncated).

Appendix: quick checklist for adding a new role-seeded prompt to the prompt library
- [ ] Vet exemplars: ensure no internal contradiction and check date phrases.
- [ ] Run 1000-sample role-truncation simulation at 256/512 budget.
- [ ] Run exemplar-contradiction stress test (insert one adversarial exemplar).
- [ ] If hallucination risk > threshold, add explicit "do not fabricate" clause and a citation filter.

End of scratchpad.
